verdict.rationale: The evidence covers only DPMA's hosted public services: the DEPATISnet search database, the DPMAregister, and the DPMAdirektWeb and DPMAdirektPro filing routes. Nothing shows the core search or register service can be deployed on a user's own infrastructure. The free downloadable DPMAdirektPro software is only a client tool for preparing filings, not a self-hosted version of the core product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
